description: The keel runner's test suite passes.
why: Three runner defects shipped in 0.5.0 — path scoping went empty the moment a task committed, an unedited Class line resolved to spike, and a missing registry silently meant no review at all. All three were mechanically testable and none was caught by reading. Reading is exactly the diligence keel says not to rely on.
fixHint: Run `bash plugins/keel/tests/run-tests.sh` to see which assertion failed; each one prints what it got.
